gloss: food waste; raw garbage; kitchen waste

definitions.gloss: food waste; raw garbage; kitchen waste
definitions.explanation: organic waste from food preparation and leftovers that can decompose and smell

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ゴミは{毎日|まいにち}{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I take out the food waste every day.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{生|なま}ゴミの{臭|にお}いがひどい。
examples.english: In summer, the smell of food waste is terrible.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ゴミは{水分|すいぶん}を{切|き}ってから{捨|す}てる。
examples.english: Drain the moisture from food waste before throwing it away.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
- {生|なま} (raw, fresh)
- ゴミ (garbage, waste)

DISPOSAL:
In most Japanese municipalities, {生|なま}ゴミ is classified as {可燃|かねん}ゴミ (burnable garbage).

TIPS:
- {水|みず}を{切|き}る (drain water to reduce smell and weight)
- {新聞紙|しんぶんし}で{包|つつ}む (wrap in newspaper)
- {冷凍|れいとう}する (freeze until collection day)

COMPOSTING:
{生|なま}ゴミ{処理機|しょりき} (food waste processor) or コンポスト (compost) can turn food waste into fertilizer.
